screenLevelIssues.explanation: The 'Choose a Payment Method' section is implemented as part of the main scrollable content flow in the Simulator. In Figma, this is a fixed Bottom Sheet overlay (Frame 2095586317) that sits on top of the screen content, starting approx 252px from the top and covering the bottom ~70% of the screen.
Missing the dark overlay backdrop (Rectangle 54) behind the bottom sheet. The content behind the sheet (Rent Details) should be dimmed and blurred.

In Figma, the Top Card (Rent Amount) and the Breakdown Card (Base Rent/Maintenance) are two separate cards separated by a 40px gap. In the Simulator, they appear as a single continuous card or are merged without spacing.

The pill component 'You’ll earn ₹325 cashback on this payment' is missing from the 'Choose a Payment Method' section in the Simulator. It should be positioned between the title and the payment options list.
screenLevelIssues.fixedCode:
<Text>Choose a Payment Method</Text>
<CashbackPill text="You’ll earn ₹325 cashback..." />
<PaymentOptionsList />

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The 'Pay ₹32,500' button in Figma has a subtle orange stroke/border and an orange-tinted shadow. The Simulator button appears flat black.

feedback.explanation: The 'Choose a Payment Method' section must be moved out of the main ScrollView and implemented as an absolute positioned Bottom Sheet overlay to match Figma structure.
feedback.fixedCode:
<View style={{flex: 1}}>
  <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{paddingBottom: 300}}>
    <RentDetails />
  </ScrollView>
  {/* Backdrop */}
  <View style={{position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)'}} />
  {/* Bottom Sheet */}
  <View style={{position: 'absolute', bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0, height: '70%', backgroundColor: colors.black[800]}}>
    <PaymentMethods />
  </View>
</View>

feedback.explanation: Add the dark overlay backdrop behind the bottom sheet (Rectangle 54).
feedback.fixedCode:
<BlurView style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} blurType="dark" blurAmount={8} />
<View style={{...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject, backgroundColor: colors.neutral.black, opacity: 0.6}} />

feedback.explanation: Insert 40px spacing between the Rent Amount card and the Breakdown card.

<View style={{backgroundColor: colors.black[600], padding: spacing.sm, borderRadius: radius.pill}}>
